newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-TWO LAUDRUPS BACK IN DANISH TEAM FOR BOSNIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO LAUDRUPS BACK IN DANISH TEAM FOR BOSNIA.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam forward Michael Laudrup, who sustained a knee injury in April, is back as captain of Denmark's team to meet Bosnia in Sarajevo in a group one World Cup qualifying match on August 20.
Michael Laudrup's brother Brian, who plays as striker for Glasgow Rangers, is also in the 18-man squad announced by national trainer Bo Johansson on Monday.
Denmark, who beat Bosnia 2-0 in a first leg qualifier in Copenhagen in June, leads the group.
Goalkeepers: Peter Schmeichel (Manchester United), Mogens Krogh (Brondby).

Defenders: Jan Heintze (Bayern Leverkusen), Thomas Helveg (Udinese), Jes Hoegh (Fenerbahce), Jacob Laursen (Derby), Marc Rieper (West Ham), Michael Schjoenberg (FC Kaiserslautern), Soeren Colding (Brondby).
Midfielders: Per Frandsen (Bolton), Allan Nielsen (Tottenham), Claus Thomsen (Everton), Jon Dahl Tomasson (Newcastle), Ole Bjur (Brondby).
Strikers: Peter Moeller (PSV Eindhoven), Brian Laudrup (Glasgow Rangers), Miklos Molnar (Lyngby), Michael Laudrup (Ajax Amsterdam).
